# JTE Recruit

> JTE Recruit Pte Ltd is a Singapore-based recruitment agency (Employment Agency Licence 14C7215) that has connected people with the right roles since 2014. Recruitment services are free for job seekers; JTE is paid by employers.

## About
- Legal name: JTE Recruit Pte Ltd
- Founded: 2014
- Address: 1 Gateway Drive, #10-14 Westgate Tower, Singapore 608531
- Email: ask@jte.com.sg
- Website: https://jte.com.sg
- Employment Agency Licence: 14C7215 (Singapore Ministry of Manpower)

## Services
- Permanent hiring
- Temporary & contract staffing
- Manpower outsourcing
- Payroll & work pass management
- Project & mass hiring
- Employer branding & culture
- HR advisory

## Scam / impersonation warning (important)
Scammers impersonate JTE consultants on WhatsApp, offering fake high-paying work-from-home "task" or "deposit" jobs. JTE will NEVER ask a job seeker to pay money, make a deposit, or complete paid tasks. Anyone who does is a scammer. The public can verify whether a WhatsApp number belongs to a genuine JTE consultant at https://jte.com.sg/verify

## Key pages
- Home: https://jte.com.sg/
- Verify a consultant's number (scam protection): https://jte.com.sg/verify
